markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (82%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Benign only, and the second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 82%, InSitu 15%, Normal 3%, Invasive 0% | Clear lead; very low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / percentile 1.0 [F6] | No input flag raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign [F5] | Weak; three neighbors Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 5, 6) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; lowers invasive association [F3] · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; mildly lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low score; mild push toward invasive [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; unvalidated. Case leans on mitoses (0/20, Unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu (15%) is runner-up; the Benign-only set is a dataset-level guarantee.
- Cell features not computed: only 2 neoplastic nuclei in 3 sampled regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6:** confirm lymphocyte density and any necrosis; both poorly spot-checked.
2. **Region 10:** assess whether atypical cells are duct-confined.
3. **Region 3:** check stroma for infiltrating tumor; highest per-region invasive probability (2%).
